intent: The receive meter is pulsing at a steady interval, so someone or something is still transmitting, but I am not keying the ham microphone until I know whether the signal is automated or monitored. I need Mike to separate what he personally witnessed from neighborhood rumor and tell me exactly what drew the woman’s attention. I hide my fear behind technical questions and one brief dry observation about our emergency plan never covering this.
emotion: relieved to hear Mike, tired, skeptical, quick, controlled, increasingly alert
